mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_task (task_id, task_name, eval_type, dataset_id, status, total_count, completed_count, model_version, rag_strategy_version, avg_overall_score, trials, pass_threshold, pass_rate, score_std_dev, gate_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{taskName}, #{evalType}, #{datasetId}, #{status}, #{totalCount}, #{completedCount}, #{modelVersion}, #{ragStrategyVersion}, #{avgOverallScore}, #{trials}, #{passThreshold}, #{passRate}, #{scoreStdDev}, #{gateId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, task_name, eval_type, dataset_id, status, total_count, completed_count, model_version, rag_strategy_version, avg_overall_score, trials, pass_threshold, pass_rate, score_std_dev, gate_id, create_time, update_time FROM eval_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT id, task_id, task_name, eval_type, dataset_id, status, total_count, completed_count, model_version, rag_strategy_version, avg_overall_score, trials, pass_threshold, pass_rate, score_std_dev, gate_id, create_time, update_time FROM eval_task ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, task_id, task_name, eval_type, dataset_id, status, total_count, completed_count, model_version, rag_strategy_version, avg_overall_score, trials, pass_threshold, pass_rate, score_std_dev, gate_id, create_time, update_time FROM eval_task WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE eval_task SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE eval_task SET completed_count = #{completedCount}, avg_overall_score = #{avgOverallScore}, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE eval_task SET total_count = #{totalCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE eval_task SET pass_rate = #{passRate}, score_std_dev = #{scoreStdDev}, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
